fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor inlined in the fighter boma builder f_71006882d0 (near 0x710068b140) stores vptr 0x7104f73620 and stores the object at boma+0x170. The second class 0x7104f737d0 (32 bytes, constructed by f_71033b9900 and inline in the g0151 builders) is the light variant for other objects; its fields +0x0..+0x1F have the same layout.

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Stored with the vptr. update and set reach LinkModule via [+0x8]+0xD0 and the boma's listener list via [+0x8]+0x18 (+0x470 / +0x4B8 lists) to broadcast events 0x2F (slot change) and 0x32 (mag change).

fields.name: rate
fields.evidence: rate (vtable +0xA8, f_71004cb460) returns the f32 here. is_slow (vtable +0x58, f_71004cac60) returns rate != 1.0. update (vtable +0x48, f_71004ca720) sets it to (1 / total_mag) times the interpolation factor of entries in their last frames; 1.0 when no entry is active; copied from the link parent when linked (+0x41). Initial 1.0; reset (vtable +0x38) writes 1.0.

fields.name: skip
fields.evidence: is_skip (vtable +0xB0, f_71004cb470) returns the byte. update: frame_accumulator (+0x20) += rate + eps (0x7104471b98); when it reaches 1 the accumulator is reset to 0 and skip=1; otherwise skip is 1 or 0 depending on whether the next step would reach 1. 0 when not slowed. Initial 0.

fields.name: prev_skip
fields.evidence: is_prev_skip (vtable +0xB8, f_71004cb480) returns the byte. update first copies skip here, then (fighter class) overwrites it with its per-frame result (0 when the accumulator wrapped or not slowed, 1 otherwise), which update also returns. Initial 0.

fields.name: whole_frame
fields.evidence: whole_frame (vtable +0xE0, f_71004cb490) returns it. set_whole(u8, frame) (vtable +0xC0, f_71004cb750) and set_whole_frame (vtable +0xD8, f_71004cb9b0, calls clear_whole when <= 0) write it; update decrements it and calls clear_whole (vtable +0xC8) when it reaches 0; clear_whole zeroes it. Initial 0.

fields.name: whole_slot
fields.evidence: Index into a global whole-slow table (pointer at 0x71052c3610; 2-byte entries at +0x20+2*i: active, mag). set_whole stores it; whole_mag (vtable +0xD0, f_71004cb970) returns table[slot].mag if slot != 0xFF and active, else 1; clear_whole deactivates the entry, sets the table dirty byte (+0x40) and writes 0xFF here. Initial 0xFF.

fields.name: frame_accumulator
fields.evidence: update accumulates rate here and resets it to 0 when it reaches 1; slot +0x50 (f_71004cac30) sets it to 1 - rate (and skip 0) when total_mag != 1; clear_immediate recomputes it. Initial 0 (stored as u32 0).

fields.name: total_mag
fields.how: computed: product of the mag of every slow entry
fields.evidence: set (vtable +0x60, f_71004cac80) recomputes it as the product of entries[i].mag when an entry's mag changes; update recomputes it while counting entry frames down. rate = 1/total_mag. Reset / clear write 1. Initial 1.

fields.name: mag_ignore_effect
fields.how: computed: product of mags of the entries whose flag +0x1C is 0
fields.evidence: rate_ignore_effect (vtable +0x78, f_71004cb030) returns 1.0 / (float)this. Written by update (64-bit store with total_mag) and copied from total_mag on the unlink path and in clear_immediate; also sent with event 0x32. Initial 1. Bytes 0x2C..0x2F padding.

fields.name: entry_count
fields.evidence: Setup (vtable +0x28, f_71004ca650) copies a 16-byte {count, entries ptr} argument to +0x30/+0x38. Loop bound in reset, clear, set, update. Initial 0.

fields.name: entries
fields.evidence: Array of 0x20-byte slow entries indexed by the slow-kind argument of set / mag / frame / clear_2 / clear_immediate. Initial 0.

fields.name: entries[i].frame
fields.evidence: frame(i) (vtable +0x80, f_71004cb050) loads entries[i]+0x0. set stores its frame argument (frame+1 with the interpolation start); update decrements it while > 0; when it drops to 0 the entry's mag goes back to 1 and its kind to 0x50000000. Reset/clear write 0.

fields.name: entries[i].mag
fields.evidence: mag(i) (vtable +0x70, f_71004cb010) loads entries[i]+0x4. set stores its mag argument and, if it changed, recomputes total_mag and sets mags_dirty (+0x40). Reset/clear write 1.

fields.name: entries[i].interp (rate_factor +0x8, progress +0xC, step +0x10)
fields.evidence: set writes +0x8 = 1/mag (or an interpolated value via slot +0x68, f_71004caf60), +0xC = 0, +0x10 = frame/mag; update adds 1/mag to +0xC each frame and multiplies rate by +0x8 for entries at frame 2 or 3; slot +0xE8 (f_71004cb4a0) sets +0x8 and adjusts +0x10.

fields.name: entries[i].kind_flags
fields.evidence: set stores its last u32 argument; clear_2 passes 0x50000000; reset/clear and frame expiry restore 0x50000000. Sent with event 0x2F.

fields.name: entries[i].mag_copy
fields.evidence: set stores the mag here too; the mag_ignore_effect product in set/update multiplies this field for entries whose +0x1C flag is 0.

fields.name: entries[i].ignore_effect_excluded
fields.evidence: set stores its bool argument; entries with it set count as 1 in mag_ignore_effect.

fields.name: mags_dirty
fields.evidence: set writes 1 when an entry's mag changes (old != 1 path); update consumes and clears it when re-deriving rate. Reset writes 0 (16-bit with +0x41). Initial 0.

fields.name: rate_from_link
fields.evidence: update: when LinkModule vtable +0x430(-1, 0xD) is true it reads the parent's slow state via LinkModule vtable +0x468 and, if the parent rate differs, copies rate/skip/prev_skip and sets this to 1; when no longer linked and set, restores rate 1.0 (if total_mag == 1) and clears it. Initial 0. Bytes 0x42..0x47 padding.

pointers.to: whole-slow table (2-byte entries at +0x20, dirty byte +0x40)

notes: Exports: set and clear_immediate have no slot in the dossier; their export functions call vtable +0x60 (set(kind, mag, frame, bool, u32)) and +0x98 (clear_immediate(kind, bool)). clear (vtable +0x88) resets all entries, total_mag 1 and broadcasts events 0x2F and 0x32; clear_2 (vtable +0x90) = set(kind, 1, 0, false, 0x50000000). Light class 0x7104f737d0 (32 bytes): only vptr, owner, rate, skip, prev_skip, whole_frame, whole_slot; its mag returns 1, rate_ignore_effect 1.0, frame 0, clear/clear_2 do nothing, and its update (f_71004cb680) copies rate/skip from the link parent (LinkModule vtable +0x460/+0x468) or sets rate 1.0, then counts whole_frame down. The two skip flags' exact meaning (skip vs advance) is inferred from the accumulator logic, not from a name in the code.
